notes.title: New Update 0.2.0!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, the long awaited update is here! Here is what's new:

- Art style -
We wanted to do give our game a unique and different art style and we landed with this low poly style. In game you will notice:
- New Tower model
- New Portal model
- New jungle creep on top replacing the vikings
- New background props to the map like troops training
We are looking to continue to polish the game and mechanics so please bring on the feedback! 

- New Wave difficulties to Practice mode! -
Now when you enter practice mode you will have the option to select your desired wave difficulty. Each mode sending out stronger minions allowing you to master your wave configuration!

Thanks for all your support in making One Tower the best it can be! We look forward to feedback to make it even better!

-Skyreacher Team

notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We've been busy playtesting some big gameplay balancing changes to One Tower. One big change is that ranged minions no longer bunch up with melee because hey have a LOT more range and unfortunately this means we've introduced new balancing issues and bugs in making this change so please hang in there while we fix them. It is worth the wait, promise.

On top of this, we have a fix coming for the 'no spawning minions' and a ton of new UI improvements.

After this update we have another large update left before we can consider going Early Access. There's the "invincible minion" bug that needs to be fixed AND the addition of a practice mode so that you aren't being thrown in to battle right away and can try out different builds prior to an actual match. 

Thanks so much for hanging in here with us! For those of you who stick with us through Early Access, you'll be getting some special shwag (possibly physical One Tower gear!) as an appreciation gift from us. 

Thanks and see you in the game!

DarkViper

notes.title: One Tower Early Access Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

As you know we've been talking about going Early Access with One Tower this month. However, we've heard you loud and clear and we're holding it back until we can address several things.

Here's what to expect:

[olist]
    [*]Various critical bug fixes. We've seen the invincible unit bug, the random no minion spawns, etc. We are working on making the game more stable in general. 
    [*]Balance, balance and more balance. We are making a huge update that will make the minion 'classes' more obvious. Stronger tanks, harder hitting fighters, greater ranged units and siege, snipers and more. Any currently OP units will have even greater weaknesses. Reaper and Wildfire are getting a few minor adjustments as well.
    [*]Many games are running over our goal of keeping matches between 10-15 minutes. We are rebalancing things to fix this. In fixing 'tower diving' we actually made it more difficult for your minions to reach the enemy tower.
    [*]Gameplay will give you more visual feedback. When you attack you'll know if you hit your target. We're adding in a lot of visual effects to make it more clear what's going on during combat vs. wondering how/why you died or if you killed something.
    [*]We're bringing on new professional voice talent to help us add better VO in general. As an Indie dev studio this isn't cheap, but you've made it clear you no longer want to hear Ryan's voice. His feelings are hurt and he cries often about this, but you're right. It is terrible and we agree with you. ;)
    [*]Solo Survival Mode. Yes! We know how important this is for you guys to be able to learn the game or practice new minion builds. We've always planned on adding this, but at the risk of delaying the game we planned on adding it later. Survival Mode will start with easier minion waves and will progressively get harder each wave until you either defeat the enemy or you are defeated.
    [*]Improvements to ability visuals, air attack range, indicators and bug fixes. 
    [*]Clarity for new players: One of the things many players struggle with include how to customize their waves with their minions, how to deploy traps, what the trader or guardian do, etc. We're working on resolving that with our upcoming UI
    [*]Many UI improvements throughout the game in general.
    [*]We're fixing many animation issues (feet sliding, attack sync, etc.)
[/olist]

Things like new heroes, new minions, new environment artwork, etc. are being worked on but will be released during Early Access. We'll be previewing these over the coming weeks!

Thanks for your support as always, it really means a lot to us and appreciate all of you who have stuck around with us as the game continues to evolve - you have really helped us make One Tower a better game!

notes.title: Update Notes - 0.0.36
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Mystic's Chain Lightning's damage is no longer treated as Hero Damage.  Gold earned from these kills would be attributed to the player.
    [*]New wraith jungle minion is in, spawns at 7 minutes into the game, high value target for end game, this unit patrols the lower jungle and attacks any heroes it finds in it's path, if it moves 10 units from where it was currently aggro'd, it will de-aggro and reset.
    [*]If a player would level multiple times, they correctly level up multiple times now and are awarded stats and skill points per level appropriately.
    [*]Neutral wolves, and Neutral vikings now level up on respawn, their level is determined by the lowest level hero in the game, this makes it so they aren't too difficult for the player at a disadvantage to take them, while still making it a challenge later in the game, rewards for these monsters also scale per level.
    [*]DayNight Cycle implemented, at 7 minutes when the wraith is spawned, the game turns to "night" and stays this way for the rest of the match.
    [*]Fixes in for game completion/tower pause issues.
    [*]Minions (neutral and owned) should stop moving/attacking on GameOver state activation, Tower should stop attacking and spawning new minions at this point as well.
    [*]If the anti-cheat toolkit is triggered, it should destroy the cheater's tower and give a winning state to the other player.
    [*]Reduced XP gain from all jungle creep
    [*]Increased the amount of xp you get from killing a hero
    [*]Reduced XP earned from killing the trader
    [*]Reduced the amount of XP from killing grunts
    [*]Increased amount of XP needed to level up overall, now incrementing by 40 instead of 25
    [*]Bjorn's E ability now affects Guardian
    [*]Server related bug fixes
    [*]Chat fixes
    [*]Crystal purchasing fixes
    [*]Other balancing and bug fixing
[/list]
